title: Jev Is 7.3x Cheaper, Not 100x
caption:
The 100x everyone quoted is measured against a model nobody was using for this.

Matthew O'Riordan sorted 5,595 posts from Jev's launch week and ran the numbers. Against frontier models, TypeSafe's 40 to 400x claim holds. But nobody sends yes-or-no questions to Fable 5.1. Against the small models you'd actually reach for, the median is 7.3x on cost and 4.7x on latency.

The part I think is underrated: it hands back a probability instead of a verdict, so a 0.51 announces itself as a coin flip. That's worth more to me than the price cut. And it was free on Vercel all week, so read that adoption curve as a ceiling.

What would you classify?
